<thought>To find a retrosynthetic template that removes a TBS protecting group, we should look for a template where the forward reaction forms a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group (i.e., adds the protecting group) and breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl. In the retrosynthetic direction this corresponds to breaking the t‑butyldimethylsilyl group and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl. Therefore we search for templates with functional_groups_broken = ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"] and functional_groups_formed = ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
